item.title: Ryan Kowalczyk is the Scholar Athlete of the Month
item.description: Ryan Kowalczyk of Pinconning High School is the Scholar Athlete of the Month, presented by Fisher Companies.Ryan Kowalczyk plays four sports at Pinconning. Ryan has earned all-conference honors in soccer, football and baseball. He is a team captain in soccer, achieved a school record 47 yard field goal and in his senior season is a starter on the district championship winning basketball team. item.title: Freeland Wins State Championship -- HSBB: Freeland 42, Unity Christian 32
item.description: EAST LANSING, MI - Freeland Falcons boys basketball won their first state title in school history, defeating Unity Christian (Hudsonville) 42-32. Every Falcons playoff win was by at least double-digits.
